# Query speed

<!-- Generated by tools/docs/db-benchmark.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

The everyday queries of One POS timed on a database built from the migrations and filled with a year of made-up sales: 5 branches × 300 bills a day × 365 days. Why the indexes are built this way is in [Database](03-database.md).

| Table | Rows |
| --- | --- |
| `order_line` | 1,916,940 |
| `pos_order` | 547,502 |
| `payment` | 536,550 |
| `erp_post` | 536,550 |
| `sales_day_item` | 362,919 |
| `customer` | 25,000 |
| `credit_note` | 2,696 |

Database size 1475 MB. Run on a desktop PC (12 threads, 16 GB) with PostgreSQL 17's default settings (128 MB shared buffers) in Docker; the live database server has more memory. Each query runs as the API runs it: as `onepos_app` with row-level security on. **Time** is the middle of 5 runs after one warm-up, planning included, measured inside the database (the network adds about 1 ms).

| Query | Time | Rows | Indexes used | Full table read |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Till: the day's bills list<br><small>Orders.cs GET /orders</small> | **4.2 ms** | 300 | `pos_order_branch_day`, `register_pkey`, `order_line_order` | `app_user` |
| Till: search the day's bills<br><small>Orders.cs GET /orders?q=</small> | **1.3 ms** | 13 | `pos_order_branch_day` | none |
| Open a bill with its lines and payments<br><small>Orders.cs GET /orders/{id}</small> | **1.2 ms** | 1 | `pos_order_pkey`, `order_line_order`, `payment_order` | none |
| Find a bill by its invoice number<br><small>Finance invoices, receipts</small> | **0.67 ms** | 1 | `pos_order_invoice_no` | none |
| Day end X/Z: takings by payment type<br><small>Days.cs day report</small> | **0.65 ms** | 3 | `payment_report (index only)` | none |

| Sales report: one branch, one month<br><small>Reports.cs Summary</small> | **3.1 ms** | 1 | `pos_order_report (index only)` | none |

| Item sales: all branches, whole year<br><small>SalesSummary.cs</small> | **47.7 ms** | 50 | none | `sales_day_item` |
| Customer by phone number<br><small>Customers.cs</small> | **0.54 ms** | 1 | `customer_phone` | none |

| FACTS queue: next documents to send<br><small>FactsPosting.cs sender</small> | **0.48 ms** | 0 | `erp_post_due` | none |
